tests: a launch-failed rolls the worktree back through a symlinked fleet root and through a symlinked worktrees directory

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/pool.ts shells out to git and DECIDES on what git prints: resolveDestroy reads `worktree <path>` lines out of `git worktree list --porcelain` and compares each against a path the kernel composed from the fleet root, and a mismatch makes stage 2 refuse the destroy that spawn's rollback depends on. The capture at witness/captures/git-worktree-list-canonicalises-paths.txt:1 is real output of that command taken 2026-09-16 on git 2.43.0, showing a worktree ADDED as $R/link/wt and REPORTED as $R/real/wt, so the assumption that git echoes the spelling it was given is false. The named test re-measures the same contract live against this machine's git before it asserts either arm, so a change in git reddens here rather than leaving the capture asserting a contract git no longer honours. THE TWO MEMBERS ARE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT AND THE DIFFERENCE IS DEMONSTRATED RATHER THAN CLAIMED: member 0 (string comparison at the call site) reddens ARM A at test/spawn.test.ts:1450, and member 1 (the plausible alternative fix, canonicalising the caller's argument in loadFleet while keeping the string comparison) leaves ARM A GREEN and reddens ARM B at test/spawn.test.ts:1499. THOSE TWO LINE NUMBERS ARE FOR THE DEFAULT TEMP SPELLING, AND UNTIL ROUND 4 THEY WERE NOT WHAT A macOS RUNNER WOULD HAVE SEEN. Measured 2026-09-16 on Linux with TMPDIR reached through a symlinked ancestor, which is the shape macOS supplies by itself (/var is a symlink to /private/var): at the pre-round-4 head BOTH members reddened at the LIVE PROBE, test/spawn.test.ts:1351 in that revision, because the probe composed the path it expected git to print out of a scratch root that was itself a non-canonical spelling. A red-witness run on that platform would therefore have recorded this witness as satisfied while NEITHER arm was exercised, which is the T-008 shape one step along: a guard that goes red for a reason other than the one it names. Round 4 canonicalises the scratch root once in makeTempDir and states the probe contract as the sentence it always meant, that git prints the realpath of the path it was given. Both members were then re-measured under both temp spellings: member 0 reddens arm A and member 1 reddens arm B in all four combinations. A single-site repair therefore cannot pass for a class fix here, because one member survives it.
